entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and sural wielder with golden protective magic who leads the Gatewatch on Amonkhet and was raised on Theros.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage planeswalker who can't affect mindless undead, uses illusions and telepathy, and is conflicted about Liliana.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who shapes a glass dome from sand and fights sand wurms with fire.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker and animist who senses the sick leylines of Amonkhet and fights with a sword formed from her staff.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who commands undead, is swallowed by a sand wurm, and emerges through the Chain Veil's power.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who left the group on Kaladesh to gather allies and told them of a rendezvous.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon whose horns tower over Amonkhet, the Gatewatch's target.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who may have warned Bolas of the Gatewatch.

entities.name: The jackal-headed god
aliases: the figure with a golden headdress
entities.description: A towering jackal-headed being with a golden headdress and two-pronged staff who destroys the undead wurms and saves the Gatewatch.

entities.name: The unseen archer
entities.description: A mysterious archer whose blazing white arrow kills the wurm threatening Liliana.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers that went to Amonkhet to attack Bolas.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A desert plane with two suns, sandstorms, undead, and an eerie fertile city, home of Bolas.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane the Gatewatch left.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city on Kaladesh from which they planeswalk.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Chandra's former home of lava pits.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's home plane, marked by Eldrazi emptiness.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane with corrupted leylines, where Liliana raised undead beside Gideon.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Gideon's childhood plane where gods intervene in mortal affairs.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes the planeswalkers pass through.

entities.name: The Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact at Liliana's side whose purple glow envelops her when she emerges from the wurm.

entities.name: Gideon's sural
entities.description: Gideon's ribbon-like blade weapon.

entities.name: The horns of Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Massive horns visible on the horizon of Amonkhet that match the image of Bolas.

entities.name: The city beneath the barrier
entities.description: A sprawling city of obelisks and temples on a fertile river, shielded by a translucent barrier.

entities.name: Sand wurms
entities.description: Enormous desert wurms that ambush the group; some are later raised as undead.

entities.name: The undead of Amonkhet
entities.description: Desiccated undead that burst from the sand, including jackal-headed warriors.

events.summary: The Gatewatch's five planeswalkers appear in the middle of an Amonkhet sandstorm.
events.quote: Five figures stood where none were moments ago, caught by surprise in the blinding sands.

events.summary: Flashback: on a Kaladesh rooftop, after Ajani leaves, the Gatewatch plans to go to Amonkhet, with Liliana navigating, to find and stop Bolas.
events.quote: We go to Amonkhet and learn what we can of Nicol Bolas's plans, then neutralize the threat he poses

events.summary: Flashback: the five planeswalk from Ghirapur.
events.quote: We traveled infinitely far yet not at all, standing still yet moving at blinding speeds.

events.summary: Chandra melts sand into a glass dome to shelter the group from the storm.
events.quote: I step forward and shape the still-liquid glass into a simple, crude dome.

events.summary: Liliana admits she knows little of where Bolas is; Nissa senses the plane's leylines are weak, and Chandra spots Bolas's horns on the horizon.
events.quote: the massive shadow of two horns pierces the sky

events.summary: Nissa senses Amonkhet's life magic is dominated by death.
events.quote: the shadow of death dominated all I could reach, as if the world itself favored the silence of the dead.

events.summary: Undead burst from the sand and grab Jace; the group fights a horde while Liliana commands undead to obey, assist and flee.
events.quote: rotting hands burst forth from the sand, grabbed Jace by the legs, and pulled him under.

events.summary: Giant sand wurms erupt, and one swallows Liliana whole.
events.quote: I watched in horror she disappeared into the gullet of an enormous wurm.

events.summary: Gideon, buried under undead, is rescued by Nissa and the two fight toward Chandra.
events.quote: Suddenly the limbs of the zombie holding my right arm were no longer attached to its torso.

events.summary: Jace's illusion lures a wurm away and Liliana emerges from a dying wurm, wreathed in the Chain Veil's purple light, then collapses.
events.quote: I watch, horrified, as Liliana steps forward out of the wurm

events.summary: Gideon kills one wurm from the inside and is flung by another; Jace proposes retreating to Kaladesh.
events.quote: I ran forward and leaped into its open maw

events.summary: Nissa kills a wurm by driving her sword into its skull.
events.quote: she drove her sword with both hands down, piercing its skull with a squish

events.summary: A dead wurm reanimates, strikes Chandra and Jace, and Nissa senses the world is under an ancient curse inverting life and death.
events.quote: This world suffered an ancient, powerful curse.

events.summary: Two zombified wurms attack; one coils around Nissa while Liliana lies in danger, forcing Gideon to choose.
events.quote: I stood, suspended, for a fraction of a second, fully aware that not making a choice meant choosing death for them both.

events.summary: A blazing white arrow kills the wurm over Liliana and a towering jackal-headed figure destroys the others and saves the group.
events.quote: She towered above me, standing at the height of a dozen men, golden headdress gleaming in the sun

events.summary: Gideon realizes there are gods on Amonkhet, in the world of Bolas.
The group reaches a ridge and sees a barrier-shielded city of obelisks and temples on a river.
events.quote: all of which formed a sprawling city that spanned as far as we could see.

events.summary: The Gatewatch decides to descend toward the city and its barrier.

relations.note: Gideon notes she may truly believe her oath.
relations.quote: Perhaps she meant her oath and believed in the purpose of the Gatewatch

relations.note: Jace reflects on years of entanglement with her.
relations.quote: My years of . . . entanglement with Liliana left me feeling like I knew less of her now than when I started.

relations.note: Jace supposes Bolas created the world.

relations.quote: the small tools I had shared with her helped her find calm
We'll trust you to navigate, then.

relations.note: She saves the Gatewatch from undead wurms.
relations.quote: And my friends were all alive because of them.

relations.note: It is the world of Bolas.
relations.quote: They were here on the world of Nicol Bolas.
